blockers: No automatic clinical PK-to-EGFR occupancy default is justified by the inspected evidence package. This is not a claim that all conditional cetuximab simulations are impossible.
Label clearance varies with dose. A fixed-CL approximation requires an explicit dose-domain justification; the general dose slider cannot be claimed to reproduce nonlinear PK.
Regulatory PK quantities use body surface area. No patient BSA, absolute dose/volume/clearance or justified fixed exposure factor is silently supplied.

Fab/domain-III kinetics and parent antibody/ECD-Fc SPR rates are different assay contexts. No averaging or cross-assay kon/koff pairing; incomplete 2022 methods access prevents an audited effective 1:1 transfer decision.
The inspected sources do not supply matched free target-site exposure, receptor turnover/internalization and competition context for a clinical cell-surface occupancy interpretation.

The accessible 2022 index renders the kon unit as Ms^-1; inverse-molar dimensional interpretation remains unverified, so its derived values are explicitly conditional math checks, not selected measurements.
missing_inputs: Declared experimental scope and molecular form: Fab assay, intact IgG effective assay, or target-site hypothesis.
Explicit BSA and dose schedule, or absolute hypothetical design values; declared constant-clearance dose domain or a separately implemented nonlinear model.
Chosen matched binding-rate pair with reviewed construct, assay and avidity applicability.
Prescribed target-site exposure and fixed-site/no-turnover/no-competition assumptions with rationale, or additional measured data.
structure_note: 1YY9 is a relevant Fab-human EGFR extracellular-domain metadata lead, not a newly verified viewer/analysis asset. Its NAG glycans must not be represented as the therapeutic drug.
follow_up_scope: Do not open another unbounded drug audit in 8E.1. A future enablement review could inspect the full SPR methods/supplement and establish an explicit assay/PK exposure scope. No replacement drug or new profile is approved here.
